messages:
jon_acme: Hey support — our rerank endpoint suddenly started returning 400 with an "empty candidates" style error after we upgraded our tokenizer. Repro below, can someone help?

maya_support: Sorry to hear that — can you paste the raw request body and response body + headers (redact keys)?

jon_acme: Here's a minimal curl we used (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"items":[{"id":"q1","query":"Find product A","candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":""},{"id":"c2","text":""}],"top_k":3}]}'
```
Response: 
```json
{
  "error":"invalid_request",
  "message":"items[0].candidates must contain candidate objects with non-empty 'text' fields"
}
```

maya_support: Looks like the candidates are being sent with empty text fields. Did your tokenizer collapse the strings? We validate non-empty text on the server.

jon_acme: We upgraded from tokenizer-lib 0.9.2 -> 1.0.0 yesterday. The new tokenizer returns empty string for inputs that are only control chars / RTL markers. Our pre-processing pipeline strips control chars which results in empty strings. This worked before because older tokenizer returned original text.

leo_sdk: :thinking: That matches an SDK/validation mismatch. We rolled in a stricter JSON schema validation in the rerank endpoint last month to prevent degenerate candidates (empty strings or whitespace-only). Previously the service tolerated them.

leo_sdk: Quick debug steps: 1) confirm your client isn't sending whitespace-only or empty candidate.text; 2) if you must send them, send the original raw string instead of empty, or filter them out on client side; 3) we can also return a more explicit error message.

jon_acme: For now we can patch our pipeline to skip candidates that become empty. Is there any chance the server will accept whitespace-only strings (e.g., a single space) as a fallback so we don't lose candidate alignment?

sana_eng: We don't want to accept pure whitespace since that hides data issues and harms ranking quality. Two options: (A) client-side filter/replace empties with a short placeholder like "[removed]" to preserve ordering, (B) filter empties and send a parallel mapping of original ids so you can remap.

jon_acme: OK we'll try option A as a stopgap. Will send results shortly.

maya_support: Thanks — if you can paste the failing request (full) we can add a small validation hint to the error to make debugging easier (e.g., indicate which candidate index is empty).

jon_acme: Pasted full request in thread via DM to you (sensitive), response unchanged. After client-side filter the rerank call succeeds.

deploy-bot: deploy for service:rerank-schema 2026-02-10T13:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

leo_sdk: Filed an SDK note (internal) to call out tokenizer upgrades in changelog and recommend filtering. I'll also open a small server-side change to include candidate index in the validation error to make this class of bug easier to triage.

jon_acme: Thanks all — workaround applied, will monitor. :thumbsup:

maya_support: Marking as resolved from support side. Reopen if you see more 400s after the patch. :eyes:
